title: Mailbox notification card: the header session name opens that session
outcome: The session name in a mailbox notification card header opens exactly that session through the existing session-selection navigation. Sender labels and the separate Open mailbox action retain their behavior. Unavailable or unknown session targets render without a dead navigation link.
acceptance: The session name in a mailbox notification card header opens exactly that session through the existing session-selection navigation; sender labels and Open mailbox remain separate.
Unavailable or unknown session targets render without a dead navigation link; the existing Open mailbox action retains its behavior.
Vitest covers the header session-name navigation, the unavailable-target rendering and the unchanged Open mailbox action, and TypeScript and the UI Vitest suite pass on the candidate.
